designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1995 as a partnership refuge on Cape Cod, owned jointly by federal, state, town and private conservation groups.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Mashpee National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1995 to preserve and protect natural resources associated with the Waquoit Bay area for the protection of waterfowl and wildlife.
